user.title: GIF
user.description: No configuration is needed. Submit to add the integration. The gif.create_gif action will then be available.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Only a single instance is allowed.

create_gif.name: Create GIF
create_gif.description: Create an animated GIF from a list of image files.

images.name: Images
images.description: List of image file paths. At least two images are required. Mixed sizes are resized to the first frame.

output_path.name: Output path
output_path.description: Path where the GIF should be saved.

loop.name: Loop
loop.description: Whether the GIF should loop. Defaults to on.

not_setup.message: The GIF integration is not set up. Add it under Settings → Devices & services.
